strings.d7.b1.name: Sapanca Train Station
strings.note0: Sapanca is 1.5 hours from Istanbul (by motorway, or by high-speed train from Arifiye). Explore the lake by car or bike. Maşukiye and Kartepe are 20 minutes away.
strings.note1: It gets very busy on summer weekends, so head to breakfast places before 10:00.
strings.note2: Trout, spread-style breakfast, ıslama köfte (Adapazarı) and chestnuts are local specialities.
strings.note3: Bungalow stays are Sapanca's signature; they cost half as much on weekdays.
strings.note4: The Kartepe summit is cool in summer at around 10°C, so bring a cardigan.
strings.note5: The lakeside path is 5 km long, and the morning mist is lovely for photos.
